question: With which of the following sports is Indian sportsperson Bhavani Devi associated?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Fencing.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tamil Nadu's** Bhavani Devi, the 1st Indian fencer to qualify for the Olympics, was felicitated by Indian Fencing Association. **
 
• **The 27-year-old qualified for the Tokyo Olympics through the Adjusted Official Ranking (AOR) method.**
 
• In March 2021 ending, Bhavani storms into the semifinals of the Women's sabre individual competition in the 31st Senior National Fencing Championships at Delhi Public School.
